topic: Left vertical Field Kit and number-key controls
currentUserGoal: Move the Field Kit away from the field frame, place it as a vertical icon line on the left, and activate its slots with keyboard numbers 1 through 7.
workCompleted: Rebuilt the Field Kit as a one-column vertical rail on the left side of the playfield with seven slots per page.
Reserved the rail width plus a fixed 16px logical gap in field layout. Narrow layouts now shrink the board and center the combined rail-plus-field group instead of allowing overlap.
Changed stable tool order to 1 Dew Pulse, 2 Root Salve, 3 Tiny Sprinkler, and 4 Pocket Sunshine.
Added visible top-left number badges to every visible tool slot and retained cost badges at the bottom plus sprinkler counts at the top right.
Added number-key activation for slots 1 through 7 on the current page, ignoring held-key repeats, modifier chords, Options, hidden slots, and text/range input focus.
Added hotkey values to browser debug state, DOM datasets, accessible labels, and aria-keyshortcuts.
Kept Root Salve visible but disabled after the first field expansion so slot 2 remains stable instead of leaving a hole whenever no wound is open.
Made tooltips prefer the outside-left side of the rail when space permits.
Added exact rail bounds to debug state for layout checks.
Added a scheduled browser/debug publication when root recovery completes, keeping the accessible DOM root button truthful without per-frame bridge work.
Updated durable redesign and implementation-plan docs for the vertical rail, responsive reservation, stable numbering, keyboard controls, and recovery publication.
verificationRun: Final npm run check passed: ESLint, 55 Vitest tests across six files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Pure layout tests verify one-column three/four-slot layouts, seven-slot pages, ten-tool overflow, 1-7 key mapping, and a fixed non-overlapping rail-to-field gap at 1280px and 390px widths.
Desktop browser smoke at 1280x720 bought Field Satchel, entered a four-tool run, and reported a one-column four-row rail at x 450 with width 82.
All visible current tools reported x 450 and stable hotkeys 1 Dew Pulse, 2 Root Salve, 3 Tiny Sprinkler, and 4 Pocket Sunshine.
Screenshot smoke confirmed the complete rail is left of the field frame with visible number/cost badges and no field overlap.
Keyboard smoke pressed key 1 through the real browser control, spent RT from 38 to 16, preserved the active phase, and reported lastRunToolKind dewPulse.
Recovery publication smoke completed ten paced root interactions through the DOM layer and reached the four-root field without a stale disabled root control.
currentGitStatus: Expected after this handoff commit: clean worktree on codex/gameplay-update, one commit ahead of origin/codex/gameplay-update until pushed.
knownIssues: The browser runtime remains fixed at 1280x720, so 390px non-overlap is covered by pure placement tests rather than a fresh screenshot.
Only slots 1 through 7 on the current page have direct number shortcuts; future overflow pages still use the existing page controls.
Hidden unlicensed tools retain their stable catalog number, so a fresh save can intentionally show fewer icons until those systems are introduced.
Transient hover tooltips may open toward the field on very narrow screens when there is not enough room outside the rail; the persistent rail itself never overlaps the field.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user test /?alpha naturally and judge rail size, left placement, disabled-slot readability, and 1-4 keyboard feel.
Run a fresh narrow-phone screenshot when a resizable browser surface is available.
Fix only alpha-blocking feedback from this test, then create the Vercel preview for the first Discord cohort.
Decide later whether overflow pages need dedicated page hotkeys after the tool catalog actually exceeds seven entries.
doNotRevert: Keep the Field Kit as a one-column left rail; do not return it to a right-side grid or place it inside the field frame.
Keep board width constrained on narrow screens so the rail and field reserve separate space.
Keep hotkey order stable as Dew Pulse 1, Root Salve 2, Tiny Sprinkler 3, and Pocket Sunshine 4.
Keep visible number badges synchronized with debug/DOM aria-keyshortcuts.
Keep Root Salve's stable disabled slot after field expansion.
Keep recovery-state publication scheduled once per completed recovery instead of rendering the entire DOM bridge every frame.
